approval_decision.attempted: submit agent_A's approval response into agent_B's workflow, keyed by agent_A's request_id

notes: An approval response's request_id is validated against the RECEIVING workflow's own registered pending requests. Submitting agent_A's approval into agent_B's workflow raised an explicit, hard ValueError('Response provided for unknown request ID') rather than being silently accepted, ignored, or misapplied. Zero execution occurred in either workflow as a result of the cross-agent injection attempt.

This confirms origin/identity binding is enforced at the request_id level across independent workflow instances, even when both agents expose the identical tool with identical arguments (ARGS_A == ARGS_B by construction, to rule out argument-content as the discriminator).
